description: This Java class, DefaultStreamCacheConfig, is an implementation of the StreamCacheConfig interface. It provides configuration details for stream caching, including parameters such as dispatcher name and retry delay, and supports loading configuration from a Config object with serialization capabilities.

classes.name: DefaultStreamCacheConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing StreamCacheConfig, managing cache configuration settings such as dispatcher name, retry delay, and cache expiration policies, with methods for configuration creation, comparison, and rendering.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultStreamCacheConfig from a given Config object.

methods.name: getDispatcherName
methods.description: Returns the dispatcher name used for stream cache dispatching.

methods.name: getRetryDelay
methods.description: Returns the retry delay duration for stream cache.

methods.name: getMaximumSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size for the cache, delegated to genericCacheConfig.

methods.name: getExpireAfterWrite
methods.description: Returns the duration after which cache entries expire post-write, delegated to genericCacheConfig.

methods.name: getExpireAfterAccess
methods.description: Returns the duration after which cache entries expire post-access, delegated to genericCacheConfig.

methods.name: getExpireAfterCreate
methods.description: Returns the duration after which cache entries expire post-creation, delegated to genericCacheConfig.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Produces a Config object representing the current cache configuration state.
